combos.title: An NBFC that is also an IRDAI corporate agent

adds.scope: Paras 32-33
adds.note: Insurance agency on a fee basis, with no risk participation, needs no RBI approval if you hold IRDAI permission as a composite corporate agent. Customers choose their own insurer for assets you finance; publicity must say insurance is voluntary, with no link to your loans; the premium goes straight to the insurer; risks of the agency business must not pass to the NBFC.
Registration, principal officer, trained specified persons, insurer tie-ups and conduct rules for corporate agents.

combos.title: An HFC that is also an IRDAI corporate agent

adds.scope: Paras 40 and 45-49
adds.note: HFCs with the prescribed net owned fund may take up fee-based insurance agency without RBI approval, with IRDAI permission. A Board-approved policy on insurance distribution, customer suitability checks, no commission paid directly to staff, no forcing a particular insurer or linking insurance to a loan, and fees disclosed in the notes to accounts.
Registration, principal officer, trained specified persons, insurer tie-ups and conduct rules for corporate agents.

combos.title: An NBFC with listed equity or debt

adds.scope: Para 13P
adds.note: On lending to related parties, a listed NBFC also follows the SEBI Listing Regulations, on top of the RBI rules.
Related party transaction approvals and disclosures under the Listing Regulations.

combos.title: An Upper Layer NBFC whose equity is not yet listed

adds.scope: Paras 42-43
adds.note: List equity within three years of being placed in the Upper Layer, and follow listed-company disclosure standards before listing, under a Board-approved policy. Not for Upper Layer NBFCs fully owned and controlled by Government.

adds.scope: Para 23
adds.note: A Board-approved roadmap to meet the disclosure requirements of a listed company under the SEBI Listing Regulations.

Entry, structure and change of control
para 16: from 01-10-2022, references in earlier instructions to NBFC-ND are read as NBFC-BL, and to NBFC-D / NBFC-ND-SI as NBFC-ML or NBFC-UL (a reference-mapping rule, not the layer test)
para 20: annual group asset-size certificate (as on 31 March)
para 27(1): within 3 months of RBI advice of UL classification

para 28: stay in UL at least 5 years; exit only after 5 consecutive years below criteria

para 17: half-yearly DQI within 2 months of half-year end

para 48: UL: report Large Exposures to RBI (DoS, CO) in the Annex I template: all large exposures, other and exempted exposures ≥10% of eligible capital, and the 10 largest exposures (frequency not stated in the Direction)

para 113, 115: co-lending: each RE's share reflected in its books within 15 calendar days of disbursement; if not transferred in time, the loan stays with the originating NBFC (later transfer only under Part A)

para 31: liquidity facility >90 days outstanding fully provided
para 44: BL 90-day NPA norm applies from 31-03-2026 (end of glide path)

regulation 12: trustees review AMC reports and net worth quarterly and report to SEBI half-yearly
